findings.entity: razor (and the cream streak on the upper lip)
findings.invariant_violated: real-mirror reflection must match the direct view of the same object at the same moment
findings.description: In the direct view the razor's white tip sits at the man's right jaw, below the sideburn and below mouth level, yet the mirror reflection in the same frame shows the razor tip up at his upper lip depositing the cream streak there. The same object is thus shown at two different face locations at one instant, and the direct view never shows the razor reaching the upper-lip position that the reflection (and the resulting lip cream) require. A milder version of the same offset recurs at 0:02 and 0:08, where the reflection places the razor more centrally at the mouth than the direct view does.
